source_review.review: Kurtz has 35 A and 15 AA PA, pick four and known college class; age proxy 21 is not missing schooling repaired for him. Kjerstad has 543 upper-minor and 33 MLB PA; a shared draft age does not imply the same readiness as Kurtz. Burger's missing school class becomes approximate draft age 21, but this does not reconstruct missing injury history. Volpe's proxy 18 is supported by age 21 and 2019 draft, independently of his future success. Judge's missing school class becomes proxy 21 at both 2016 and 2024, yet established MLB production must dominate later. Every fixed case's official counts and origin-selected peers were read. Green is a less similar, high-exposure/younger-draft peer to Kurtz; the saved peer rule is not claimed as exact matching on professional history.
source_review.cohort_reasonability: Among these narrow first-season older top picks before the 2024 class, only Swanson and Wilson reached MLB next year; 2020 is separately canceled. Four of nine from the 2024 class did, not all nine. Low next-year expected PA for Kurtz can be reasonable in earlier cohorts, while his longer-run talent remains unresolved. Do not force every high draft choice into a full immediate MLB season.
source_review.age_limits: Known approximate draft ages range 16 to 27; 47 player/draft combinations drift by at most one year across reported season ages. This is not precise birthday-at-draft data. 37 of 195 first-year 2024 drafted rows have unknown age and cannot be imputed as college players; removing their known school flags may lose genuine information. This is a fair representation comparison, not proof the new encoding repairs every source limitation.
